name: Wicklen
description: The trading and automation layer for Lighter perps: Bots, strategy building, backtesting, terminal, and risk controls.
longDescription:
Wicklen is the trading and automation workspace built specifically
for Lighter perpetuals. Research markets, turn ideas into tested
strategies, trade manually or run bots, and follow their decisions
and results—all in one place.

Trade crypto, equity, index, FX and commodity perpetuals available on
Lighter, with a connected toolkit for manual and systematic trading:

- Advanced trading terminal. Work with up to four independent charts,
  live order books, trade tape, indicators and drawings. Manage
  orders and TP/SL directly on the chart, with risk-based sizing,
  Pilot Entry, Scaled Entry, TWAP and Iceberg execution.

- Build and test without code. Create long and short entry, exit and
  filter rules in Strategy Lab, including multi-timeframe logic.
  Preview signals, backtest supported setups on stored Lighter-native
  candles, and compare equity curves, drawdowns, trades, fees,
  slippage and historical funding. Holdout results help you assess
  how a strategy behaved across different parts of the test period
  before preparing a live Strategy Bot.

- Automation for your approach. Configure Grid, DCA, Market Making,
  Pairs and custom Strategy Bots, or connect TradingView and other
  webhook signals to saved execution and risk settings. Start from
  editable Trend, Breakout, Pullback, Reclaim, Volatility and Mean
  Reversion templates.

- Bots you can understand. See why a bot acts or waits, inspect live
  rule values and confirmation progress, and view its positions,
  orders, fills and protection together. Connect reported performance
  to Lighter-confirmed trades.

- Risk controls you choose. Set multiple take-profit and stop-loss
  levels, trailing exits and emergency safeguards. Guardian monitors
  exposure, margin, liquidation distance and protection across
  connected accounts, with configurable warnings, restrictions on new
  risk and emergency reductions. Optional Liquidation Guard maintains
  a stop on Lighter designed to trigger before estimated liquidation.

- Market context that goes deeper. Bias and Activity Radar help you
  investigate positioning, changing attention, funding, open
  interest, liquidity and squeeze or trap conditions. Open the
  evidence behind a reading and receive alerts for watched markets.

- Analytics across your wallets. Bring manual and automated trading
  into one view, or focus on a wallet, subaccount, market or bot.
  Review realized and live PnL, drawdowns, win rates, fees, funding
  and trade history to understand what is driving your results.

Use Wicklen on desktop, tablet or phone, with an installable web app
and configurable push notifications. Bots, managed orders and
protection monitoring continue on Wicklen’s servers when your browser
is closed; selected critical alerts also have email backup.

  Funds stay in your Lighter account. Connect through revocable Lighter
  API credentials, encrypted at rest, with passkey and authenticator
  security options.

  Wicklen charges 0% trading-volume fees and adds no integrator trading
  fee. Applicable Lighter fees and funding still apply.
